**PaintFE v1.5.4**

Layered PSDs now save with lossless compression where it helps. Script API 2 gives plugin authors repeatable random seeds, points they can pick from the preview, and native tools for drawing, blending and sampling pixels.

This update adds shortcuts for Paste as New Layer and Duplicate Layer. It also improves pen tracking, selection resizing, Fill antialiasing and scale entry, and keeps clicks in Document Info from drawing on the canvas.

Related to issues 246, 250, 251, 252, 253, 254, 255 and 258, and discussion 257.
